name: morph-dialog
title: Morph dialog
author: Eduardo Retana
description: The trigger grows into a modal dialog. Focus is trapped, Escape and the backdrop close it, and focus returns to the trigger.

meta.descriptionEs: El disparador crece hasta un diálogo modal. El foco queda atrapado, Escape y el fondo lo cierran, y el foco vuelve al disparador.

examples.title: Diálogo morph
examples.description: El disparador crece hasta un diálogo modal. El foco queda atrapado, Escape y el fondo lo cierran, y el foco vuelve al disparador.

examples.title: Estrés

api.name: label / title / description
api.description: Trigger label, dialog name, and optional description.

api.name: closeLabel
api.description: Accessible name of the close control. Default Close.

docs: Clean-room shared-element dialog using motion layoutId. Blendy is the behavior reference only and is not a dependency. Reduced motion skips the morph. Initial focus lands on the first content control. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
